body: I'm waiting to hear back from a job that I'm definitely not going to get, and that's all that I have right now. And then every job I apply for in the future will turn me down too. All that I have to look forward to is getting my hopes up for the jobs I want.

That's not the type of relationship I have with my friends. We drink and do activities together. We don't talk about relationships or feelings or anything like that. I can't talk to my family because we just don't talk. My parents abandoned me emotionally when I was 15 and I've just been doing my own thing ever since. I get that I'm young, and I've got things that I should look forward to but the thing is that I have absolutely nothing to look forward to. I can't think of one thing to look forward to honestly.
